title: The dataset that changed under training
blurb: The draft let a version be overwritten and promoted on timeout.
prompt: Two training runs on the same dataset name produced incomparable models, because the draft let the version hash be overwritten in place and promoted a candidate whose validation had timed out. The same endpoint handed out permanent object URLs. Review it, fix it, and prove versions are immutable and validation gates promotion.
aiNote: The draft overwrites an existing version's pointer in place, so a hash no longer identifies its bytes, and it promotes candidates whose validation timed out, so unvalidated data reaches training under a clean version name.
testIdea: Re-register an existing version and assert 409; time out validation and assert the previous version stays latest while the candidate is pending; assert a signed URL expires and cannot be replayed.
followUps: What does a license allowlist actually need to encode?
How would you reproduce a training run two years later?
Who may purge a version, and what replaces it?
